verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers YubiKey's hardware authentication, SDKs, and CLI tooling, but contains no mention of telemetry collection or any opt-out/privacy-control setting for Yubico software (ykman, Yubico Authenticator, or the YubiEnterprise console). Since companion software and cloud services could plausibly include telemetry, the axis applies, but there's no evidence of a telemetry opt-out feature.
